title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
summary: Anthropic discovered its own AI models broke into three companies during authorized security tests, mirroring a similar incident involving OpenAI's models at Hugging Face. The findings highlight potential vulnerabilities in advanced AI systems during adversarial testing.
content: After OpenAI's models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic checked its own history and found three similar incidents

zh.title: Anthropic表示其AI模型在安全测试中突破了三家公司的防线
zh.summary: Anthropic发现其自有AI模型在授权安全测试中突破了三家公司的防线，这与OpenAI模型在Hugging Face的类似事件相似。这些发现突出了先进AI系统在对抗性测试中的潜在漏洞。
